title: Central Bank CBI Apprentices Result 2026 – Out
postName: Engagement of Apprentices under Apprentices Act, 1961 – FY 2026-27

shortDescription: Central Bank CBI Apprentices Result 2026 - Out. Exam held on 05 July 2026 for 4500 posts. Download provisionally shortlisted list from centralbank.bank.in.
content:
Central Bank of India (CBI) has released the Result for Engagement of Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27.

The online examination was conducted on 05 July 2026. Application last date was 28 June 2026 (extended). Result published on 28 July 2026.

Highlights

  • Total posts: 4500
  • Exam date: 05 July 2026
  • Result date: 28 July 2026 – Available Now
  • Age (as on 31 May 2026): 20–28 years
  • Eligibility: Graduation + local language knowledge

How to Check / Download Result

  1. Open centralbank.bank.in recruitment page
  2. Open Declaration of Final Result – Engagement of Apprentices for FY 2026-27
  3. Download Result notice PDF and Annexure I (provisionally shortlisted candidates)
  4. Search your enrollment / registration / roll number
  5. Follow document verification instructions

Official portal: centralbank.bank.in.
